# Verifies `dump --stage lowered --list` succeeds for every shipping platform.
# InlinePure runs always-on, and a platform-package override must inline to
# declared primitives or the build fails.

sngl dump --stage lowered --lang go --platform bubbletea --list main.sngl
stdout 'caps: NoTernary,NoListLambdas,StructComponents,StdlibContextParam,NoInlineComponents,NoStructSpread,NoImplicitRecv,FocusOrder,Canvas'
stdout 'passes: ForeignPrimitive → PlatformExtensionBody → PlatformFilter → PropBindings → RefLoop → NoListLambdas → Context → InlinePure → NoInlineComponents → NoStructSpread → NoImplicitRecv → Canvas → NoTernary → FocusOrder'

sngl dump --stage lowered --lang go --platform fyne --list main.sngl
stdout 'caps: NoTernary,NoListLambdas,StructComponents,StdlibContextParam,NoReactivity,NoInlineComponents,NoStructSpread,NoDeclarative,Canvas'
stdout 'passes: ForeignPrimitive → PlatformExtensionBody → PlatformFilter → PropBindings → RefLoop → NoListLambdas → Context → InlinePure → NoInlineComponents → NoStructSpread → Canvas → NoReactivity → NoTernary → CanvasReactivity → NoDeclarative'

# html emits HTML and JS; the language emits only the server half of route
# mode. So a restriction that exists because the language lacks a construct is
# not html's -- NoTernary is absent here for the same reason it is absent under
# --lang none, even though Go asks for it.
sngl dump --stage lowered --lang go --platform html --list main.sngl
stdout 'caps: NoAsyncReactive,NoListLambdas,StructComponents,StdlibContextParam,NoReactivity,NoInlineComponents,NoStructSpread,NoImplicitRecv,Canvas'
stdout 'passes: ForeignPrimitive → PlatformExtensionBody → PlatformFilter → PropBindings → RefLoop → NoAsyncReactive → NoListLambdas → Context → InlinePure → NoInlineComponents → NoStructSpread → NoImplicitRecv → Canvas → NoReactivity → CanvasReactivity'

sngl dump --stage lowered --lang none --platform html --list main.sngl
stdout 'caps: NoAsyncReactive,StructComponents,StdlibContextParam,NoReactivity,NoInlineComponents,NoStructSpread,NoImplicitRecv,Canvas'
stdout 'passes: ForeignPrimitive → PlatformExtensionBody → PlatformFilter → PropBindings → RefLoop → NoAsyncReactive → Context → InlinePure → NoInlineComponents → NoStructSpread → NoImplicitRecv → Canvas → NoReactivity → CanvasReactivity'

sngl dump --stage lowered --lang go --platform gtk4 --list main.sngl
stdout 'caps: NoTernary,NoListLambdas,StructComponents,StdlibContextParam,NoReactivity,NoInlineComponents,NoStructSpread,NoDeclarative,Canvas'
stdout 'passes: ForeignPrimitive → PlatformExtensionBody → PlatformFilter → PropBindings → RefLoop → NoListLambdas → Context → InlinePure → NoInlineComponents → NoStructSpread → Canvas → NoReactivity → NoTernary → CanvasReactivity → NoDeclarative'

sngl dump --stage lowered --lang kotlin --platform android --list main.sngl
stdout 'caps: StructComponents,StdlibContextParam,NoInlineComponents,NoStructSpread,Canvas'
stdout 'passes: ForeignPrimitive → PlatformExtensionBody → PlatformFilter → PropBindings → RefLoop → Context → InlinePure → NoInlineComponents → NoStructSpread → Canvas'

# Unknown pass name surfaces a non-zero exit.
! sngl dump --stage lowered --lang go --platform bubbletea --after NoBogus main.sngl

-- main.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"

component main {
    text(value="hello")
}
